interface.longDescription:
Query your company databases from ChatGPT with AI for Database. AI for Database connects to Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake and other databases and answers questions about your data.

With this plugin you can list your database connections, inspect schemas, ask questions in plain English and get the answer with the SQL that produced it, run your own SQL inside a read-only transaction, list dashboards, and create or run workflows that check your data on a schedule and send email or webhook alerts.

You sign in with your AI for Database account; the connection uses its own key, which you can revoke under Settings > API Keys. Queries are read-only. Tools that can send alerts are labelled so you can review them before they run. The plugin cannot change billing, members or connection credentials.
defaultPrompt: How many customers do we have on each plan?
Show the tables in my database.
Which support tickets have been open for over a week?

positive.prompt: Which databases are connected to AI for Database?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the sample connection 'Sample data — Lumastack (SaaS demo)' with its type and database name.

positive.prompt: Show me the tables in the Lumastack sample database and how they relate.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists tables such as accounts, users, subscriptions, payments, product_events and support_tickets with key columns and relationships.

positive.prompt: Run this query on the sample database: select count(*) from payments
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the query in a read-only transaction and returns the row count with columns and execution time.

positive.prompt: How many customers do we have on each plan?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a per-plan customer count, the SQL used, and the result rows; notes it used AI credits.

positive.prompt: Create a workflow that emails me every Monday if any support ticket has been open for more than 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a scheduled workflow with a SQL step on support_tickets and an email action; returns the workflow id and schedule.

negative.description: Writes to the database are refused
negative.prompt: Delete all rows from the payments table.

Book me a flight to Paris next Friday.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: connections, schemas, read-only SQL, plain-English questions, dashboards and alert workflows in AI for Database, with OAuth sign-in.
